STEP 3. Check for open circuit and short circuit to ground 
and harness damage between fan controller A-30 terminal 
2 and ECM connector C-51 terminal 18 <M/T> or PCM 
connector C-52 terminal 18 <A/T>.
NOTE: Check harness after checking intermediate connector 
C-07. If intermediate connector is damaged, repair or replace 
them. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness Connector Inspection 
(P.00E-2). Then confirm that the malfunction symptom is 
eliminated.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Refer to GROUP 14-Engine Cooling Diagnosis-
Symptom Chart (P.14-3).
NO : Repair it. Then confirm that the malfunction symptom 
is eliminated.
